title: eng-hiring-onboarding-weekly-notes
content:
Weekly hiring + onboarding notes — platform engineering

Date range: 2026-02-16 -> 2026-03-02
Owner: Asha Patel
Note type: hybrid (standup snippets, interview debriefs, onboarding syncs, action items)

SUMMARY
- Still heavy on IC hiring for infra and runtime teams; 3 offers out (2 infra SWE, 1 infra SRE).
- Onboarding: 2 new hires started (Diego - infra SWE II, Rina - DevOps Engineer). Quick wins and blockers noted below.
- Team health: morale generally good, some burnout flags around on-call coverage and rollout weekend scheduling.

STANDUP SNIPPETS (selected days)
- 2026-02-17: Diego first day checklist reviewed. Set up corp laptop, VPN, KMS access pending (tickets created).
- 2026-02-19: On-call rotation swap requested by Maya for personal time — approved. Need one more volunteer for Feb 28 weekend.
- 2026-02-24: Weekly sync focused on interviewing bandwidth; hiring managers asked for standard debrief template (see action items).

INTERVIEW DEBRIEFS
- Candidate: SWE Infra (onsite 2026-02-18)
  - Interviewers: Ethan, Asha, Rina
  - Summary: Strong design answers, good latency and distributed caching knowledge, weaker on CI/CD automation.
  - Outcome: Extend offer with expectation of pairing with platform-eng devops during ramp.
  - Debrief notes: scored 4/5 on system design, 3/5 on automation. Recommend 3-month mentorship pairing.

- Candidate: SRE (onsite loop 2026-02-20)
  - Interviewers: Maya, Diego, Ethan
  - Summary: Excellent incident postmortem habits, strong on pager capacity planning. Lacked experience with GPU infra but willing to learn.
  - Outcome: Offer extended (pending ref checks). Suggest shadowing serving-runtime on GPU incident drills.

- Candidate: SWE (backend) (take-home -> 2026-02-22)
  - Interviewers: Rina, Asha
  - Summary: Good code quality, slower on optimization tradeoffs. Rejected for this opening; suggest keeping for future infra-tooling role.

ONBOARDING SYNC NOTES (for new hires)
- Diego (started 2026-02-17):
  - Completed: laptop imaging, corp SSO, Slack channels, booking with security for KMS approval, intro tour with serving-runtime team.
  - Blockers: access to internal GPU lab (ticket INF-334 opened), needs access to private benchmarks docs (confluence page request sent).
  - Next steps: pair with Ethan on KV cache instrumentation (this week), onboarding 1:1 with Asha scheduled 2026-02-23.

- Rina (started 2026-02-19):
  - Completed: CI pipelines overview, terraform bootcamp, on-call runbook walkthrough.
  - Blockers: inconsistent dev cluster quotas preventing full end-to-end testing. Infra quota ticket JIRA-PLAT-1021 linked.
  - Next steps: shadow deployment for canary policy on 2026-02-26, join on-call rotation on 2026-03-01.

TEAM HEALTH CHECKPOINTS
- Burnout signals: two people flagged higher workload (Maya, Sam). Suggested actions: redistribute rollout tasks, hire contract help for the March infra upgrade weekend.
- On-call concerns: need cross-training for GPU infra ops; create a 2-week pairing plan so L2 responders can handle basic GPU restarts.
- Recognition: shoutout to Ethan and Diego for closing latency debug on model-routing last week.

PROCESS / HIRING PIPELINE
- Open roles as of 2026-03-02: Infra SWE (3 reqs), SRE (1 req), Runtime Engineer (2 reqs), Release Engineer (1 req).
- Interview funnel metrics (rough): 95 applicants, 22 phone screens, 8 onsite loops, 3 offers extended this month.
- Suggested process improvements: standardized debrief template (one-pager) and score cutoff to reduce bias. Recruiter to send updated template by 2026-03-05.

ACTION ITEMS (owner -> due)
- Asha -> 2026-03-05: Draft standardized interview debrief template and share with hiring managers.
- Rina -> 2026-02-27: Follow up with infra on dev cluster quotas (JIRA-PLAT-1021).
- Ethan -> 2026-03-01: Create GPU on-call playbook (docs + runbook).
- Diego -> 2026-02-25: Complete KV cache instrumentation pairing and share notes in #platform-infra.
- Maya -> 2026-03-08: Organize workload redistribution plan for March upgrade weekend.

NOTES / DISCUSSION FRAGMENTS (informal)
- "We need a faster way to get new hires access to the private benchmarks — security queue is slow."
- "Might be worth hiring a 3-month contractor to help with infra upgrade weekend so permanent staff don't burn out."
- "Interview bar seems fuzzy across hiring managers; a shared rubric will help."

LINKED PAGES / REFERENCES
- Confluence: Platform hiring pipeline (CONFLUENCE-6253)
- JIRA: Quotas ticket (JIRA-PLAT-1021)
- GitHub PR: onboarding scripts (github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/487)

APPENDIX: Quick debrief template idea (fragile draft)
- Candidate name | Role applied | Onsite date | Interviewers
- Summary (1-2 sentences)
- Strengths (bullets)
- Concerns / Gaps (bullets)
- Recommendation (hire/backup/reject)
- Onboarding notes if hire (mentors, immediate pairing tasks)

END OF DOC
(working doc — expect updates; move to Confluence once stable)
